caption: The drawing depicts a central human figure with long brown hair and a halo behind the head, standing with arms outstretched and wrists tied to the horizontal arm of a large green cross with brown bands. The figure is dressed in a long red robe with a blue outer garment that has a yellow border, and the garment opens slightly at the front. The background of the composition is a muted yellow, and the rectangular area containing the cross is bordered by irregular, torn or worn white patches at the four corners, revealing the underlying surface. The cross is painted a dark green color and intersects vertically and horizontally through the center of the image. The person's feet are bare and appear to rest against the vertical arm of the cross. At the bottom right corner of the image, the text "MARIE G. CLAFLIN TAOS. N. MEXICO." is written in small, green capital letters. The overall composition is centered within a rectangular frame and the image appears to be done with colored paints or possibly watercolor, giving it a textured effect.
title: Painting of St. Liberata
